title: Win floor per mission
description: The fewest seconds a victory may take before the server stops paying coins for it (GH-1075 A2). One entry per world mission: floor(fastest 30-seed scripted win / 4), a quarter so a player at 2x speed keeps a factor of 2. Generated by `pnpm playtest -- --min-win`; never hand-edited. A mission the file does not name has floor 0.
